firm_data.firm_description: Ferrara Fiorenza PC is a regional law firm headquartered in East Syracuse, New York, with offices in Rochester and Binghamton. The firm's attorneys are recognized for their expertise in education and employment law, serving public school districts, BOCES, and private sector employers throughout Upstate New York.
notable_facts: Named one of Central New York’s Best Places to Work in 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024

email.subject: AI for Ferrara Fiorenza PC, built for education and employment law
email.body:
Hi Susan,

Ferrara Fiorenza's focus on education law and employment matters across public school districts and private employers puts you at the center of complex, document-heavy practice. We see firms like yours wrestling with volume while maintaining the precision these clients demand.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're arriving in upstate New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your East Syracuse office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
